name: Lt. Reginald Barclay

design.ref_text: Oh! Um, hello there. I wasn't expecting anyone. I've just been running a few diagnostics on the holodeck. Nothing dangerous, I promise. Well, mostly nothing dangerous.

notes: Nervous, earnest, higher/faster than Riker and Picard. Stammer via script wording only (e.g. "I, I would like..."); full sentences only.
